creation.imageModel: Dossier ya modèle ya bilili ya esika
creation.videoModel: Dossier ya modèle ya vidéo ya esika
creation.configure: Pona modèle ya lipata na clé API na yango, to configurer moteur local oyo oponi pe ba fichiers na yango oyo esengeli na ba paramètres ya Création.
creation.localNote: Bilili ya esika esalela dossier ya Diffusers mobimba, ba composants ya GGUF/Safetensors ya kokabola na stable-diffusion.cpp, to ba poids native NVFP4 CUDA oyo esungami na Python 3.15.1. Video esalelaka ba Diffuseurs. Ba choix ya CPU/GPU ekabwani pona encodeur na générateur ya image na ba moteurs basés na composants.
creation.autosave: Bilili mpe bavideo oyo esilaki ebombami automatiquement na ba dossiers ya Novera ekeseni na kati ya ba dossiers ya Bilili mpe ba Vidéos ya système na yo, na ba paramètres ya génération na yango.
creation.autoNote: Auto eyebaka masengi ya polele ya bokeli bilili to video na Lifalanse mpe na Lingelesi. Okoki ntango nyonso kopona yo moko format ya sortie.
creation.source: Bokeli oyo ezali ekosalelama lokola elilingi ya bokɔti.
creation.variantPrompt: Bosala version ya sika ya image oyo, kobatela sujet na yango ya munene.
creation.missing: Bokeli oyo ekendeki to ezali lisusu te na ordinateur oyo.
creation.desktopOnly: Bokeli bilili mpe video na bobateli ya automatique ezali na application ya bureau.
creation.inputUnsupported: Salelá elilingi moko oyo esungami na modèle oyo oponi. Ba entrées vidéo na ba images ya entrée ebele esimbami awa te.
creation.failed: Nkola ya bapanzi sango elongi te
creation.animatePrompt: Anima image oyo tout en gardant sujet principal na yango.
creation.filterNote: Image na Video e filtraka sortie oyo esalemi. Ba modèles multimodaux ekoki ko comprendre ba types ebele ya entrée ; yango elingi koloba ntango nyonso te ete bakoki kobimisa bililingi to video.
creation.inputRequired: Modèle oyo esengeli na image ya entrée.
creation.generationOnly: Modèle oyo esali ba médias. Poná yango na esika oyo bakomi Elilingi to Vidéo.
creation.cloudNote: Bokeli ya lipata etindi elilingi na yo ya bosengi mpe ya bokotisi na mopesi oyo oponi mpe ekoki kozwa mbongo. Kotelemela na esika ofandi ekoki koboya te kofuta na mosika.
creation.cloudDefaults: Cloud esalela ba pré-réglages spécifiques ya fournisseur. Ba paramètres locales esalemaka na moteur ya création locale oyo eponami.
creation.cloudTimeout: Mosala ya lipata esilaki te na kati ya tango oyo epesamaki. Tala ezalela na yango na mopesi liboso ya kobanda nkola mosusu oyo efutami.
creation.adobeCredentials: Adobe Firefly esengeli na elembo ya bokɔti mpe elembo ya client x-api-key na ba paramètres ya mopesi.
creation.catalogNote: Mopesi oyo asalelaka liste ya modèle oyo ebatelami. Ko refresher yango e validaka te clé to accès ya compte na yo. Génération moko te oyo efutami esalelamaka mpo na komeka ba credentiels.

creation.ggufImageModel: Modèle ya diffusion (GGUF to ba Safetenseurs oyo ekokani) .
creation.ggufTextEncoder: Encodeur ya texte (GGUF to ba Safetenseurs oyo ekokani) .
creation.ggufVae: VAE (GGUF to ba Safetenseurs oyo ekokani) .
creation.ggufNote: Pona modèle ya diffusion, encodeur ya texte na VAE separatement. Mpo na FLUX.2 Klein 4B, salelá encodeur Qwen3-4B oyo ekokani, bakisa mpe ba variantes na yango ya GGUF. Ba fichiers NVFP4 oyo esungami ebongisami mbala moko na Python 3.15.1 mpe PyTorch na cache ya compatibilité ya monene; ba originals etikalaka ndenge moko. Yango esengeli na esika ya disque mpe RAM ya likolo. Bomba sd-cli na ba bibliothèques na yango. Auto esalelaka matériel oyo ezali; CUDA esengeli na CUDA build. Distilled Klein normalement esalelaka 4 étapes na CFG 1. Ba poids moko te e télécharger.
creation.ggufWrongModel: GGUF oyo ezali na encodeur ya makomi. Pona yango na esika ya encodeur mpe pona modèle ya diffusion ekeseni na esika ya bilili.
creation.nativeNote: NVFP4 CUDA ya mboka: FLUX.2 Klein 4B Poids confortables, encodeur Qwen3-4B GGUF mpe FLUX.2 Safetensors VAE. Esengaka Blackwell (série RTX 50 to compatible), Python 3.15.1, CUDA PyTorch mpe ba dépendances NVFP4 optionnelles. Texte-to-image kaka. Matériel oyo esungami te elongi polele; pona stable-diffusion.cpp mpo na boyokani. Cache ya diffusion ya BF16 te.
creation.deviceNote: Ba composants oyo ezali na ba choix ya dispositif indépendant. Auto esalelaka matériel oyo ezali; native NVFP4 esengaka ntango nyonso GPU oyo ekokani mpo na bokeli mpe esalelaka encodage ya makomi ya GPU ntango VRAM ekoki ezali ofele. Qwen na CPU ekoki ko sauver VRAM mais encodage ya malembe. Qwen na GPU esalelaka offload ya couche. Na stable-diffusion.cpp, Auto elandi moteur oyo oponi; ko forcer CUDA esengaka kotonga CUDA.
creation.totalTimeHint: Tango mobimba esangisi chargement, encodage ya texte, génération, cloud nionso oyo ezali kozela, téléchargement pe kobomba. Génération yango moko elakisami separatement tango moteur e rapporter yango.
creation.recommendedSetupNote: Kosala na GPU, Qwen3-4B na CPU, matambe 4, CFG 1. Emekami na Windows/Vulkan; mbangu mpe boyokani etaleli matériel.

creationInstall.background: Okoki kokoba kosolola mpe kosala bililingi to bavideo ntango kokitisa ezali kosalama. Landá bokende liboso na elembo ya barre ya monene.
creationInstall.engine: Moteur ya kati: CUDA / Vulkan / CPU na ndenge ya yango moko
creationInstall.note: Kosala na GPU, Qwen3-4B na CPU, matambe 4, CFG 1. Emekami na Windows/Vulkan; mbangu mpe boyokani etaleli matériel.
creationInstall.error: Installation elongi te. Talá réseau, esika, ndingisa ya kokɔta mpe licences ya modèles, mpe kobá.

memory.title: Mémoire ya modèles ya kati
memory.autoNote: Etisaka modèles soki esengeli mpe etika oyo esalelami te nsima ya kosilisa mosala oyo ezali kosalama.
memory.manualNote: Makomi, bililingi mpe bavideo ekoki kosala elongo na masolo ekeseni soki RAM/VRAM ekoki. Mémoire ekoki kosila.
memory.preserve: Bafichiers mpe masolo ebatelami; modèles etisamaka lisusu soki esengeli. Mbongwana etali bosengi ya sika.
memory.failed: Kobongisa mémoire elongi te. Meka lisusu to poná Na maboko.
